description: The signed-in company in Przetargowy Janusz: what it does — its matching profile (matching_profile: CPV codes with names, voivodeships, budget, interests and its own description of what it does and doesn't do), from which its matched tenders come — and the details Janusz writes into offer documents: name, address, NIP, REGON, KRS, contact and the default signatory, with those missing. The NIP is set only in the app (profile_url, checked in the GUS register); the rest with set_company_details. The matching profile changes only with set_matching_profile. Requires OAuth authentication and a trial or paid plan.
name: get_company_profile
